+917008688366Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Linked In

sitaramkesharim@gmail.comABOUT MESoftware Developer with 3+ years of experience in Angular (v10+), ReactJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Java andRESTful APIs, specializing in building scalable and high-performance web applications. Skilled in FullStack development,performance optimization, and Agile collaboration, with proven client-facing experience. Worked closely with testers,UI/UX designers, and product managers to deliver responsive, scalable, and user-friendly applications.WORK EXPERIENCERumango Software and Consulting Services Pvt Ltd. - Associate Software Developer2021(Aug) - 2024(Sept)Software Development:

Developed and maintained scalable and responsive web applications using Angular and React.

Applied Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and design patterns to write clean, structured, and reusablecode.

Ensured all applications followed modular architecture for easy maintenance and future scalability.

Collaborated with backend teams to align front-end design with APIs and server-side logic.UI/UX Optimization

Improved application performance, speed, and usability by optimizing code and reusing components.

Worked closely with UI/UX designers to ensure consistent branding and a user-friendly interface.

Fixed cross-browser issues and implemented responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

Participated in regular code reviews to maintain quality and consistency across the project.API Integration & Security

Integrated REST APIs and microservices into Angular and React applications to enable smooth data flow betweenfrontend and backend systems.

Implemented secure authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth2, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

Followed best security practices to protect sensitive user and client data during API communication.

Ensured all integrations were thoroughly tested and well-documented for easy maintenance.Agile Collaboration

Actively contributed to Agile and Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Worked closely with product managers, QA testers, and designers to deliver features on schedule.

Mentored junior developers on Git workflows, clean coding standards, and project best practices.

Maintained open communication with stakeholders for smooth delivery and transparency.Testing & Tooling

Followed Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices for reliable code quality.

Created unit and integration tests using Jasmine, Karma, and React Testing Library.

Used tools like Angular CLI, NPM, Chrome DevTools, and Postman for efficient debugging and testing.

Ensured new features passed quality checks before deployment to production.Cloud, Deployment & Documentation

Supported CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions to automate build and deployment processes.

Deployed web applications on Oracle WebLogic Server ensuring stable and secure releases.

Created technical documentation, user guides, and process notes for smooth handover and knowledge transfer.

Collaborated with DevOps teams to monitor deployments and resolve production issues efficiently.Rumango Software and Consulting Services Pvt Ltd.SKILLS

Programming Languages: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Java, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS

Frontend Frameworks & Libraries: ReactJS, Angular (v10+), RxJS, NgRx, JSX, Responsive & Accessible UI (WCAG),Reusable Component Development, Material UI, Bootstrap

Frontend Development: Responsive UI, Cross-browser compatibility, Component optimization.

API Development & Integration: REST APIs, Microservices collaboration, JSON, JWT, OAuth2, RBAC

Testing & Quality Assurance: Unit Testing, TDD, BDD, Manual Testing, React Testing Library

Build & Tools: NPM, CLI, Chrome DevTools,Angular DevTools, Postman, VS Code

Backend & Databases: RESTful APIs, JSON, PostgreSQL, Oracle

Cloud & DevOps: Oracle WebLogic Server, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

Software Engineering Practices: OOP, Design Patterns, Agile/Scrum methodologies

Documentation & Collaboration: Technical documentation, Sprint planning, Code reviews, Knowledge transfer, Clientcommunication

EDUCATIONB.TECH (APRIL 2016 - JUNE 2020) : ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING - (PERCENTAGE: 67%)Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan University (SOA), ITER, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, IndiaPROJECTSiCust – Core Banking Application

Developed and optimized key modules like Customer Onboarding, Loan Accounts, and Kiosk Portal for B2B and B2Cclients.

Integrated REST APIs with secure authentication (JWT, OAuth2, RBAC) to enhance system security and scalability.

Built reusable UI components improving development speed and code maintainability.

Worked closely with UI/UX designers and backend developers under Agile Scrum practices for on-time delivery.

Impact: Improved onboarding efficiency by 30% & reduced page load time by 25% through UI and API optimizations.Median – Middleware Processor

Built middleware modules to integrate multiple banking systems, enabling seamless and secure data exchange.

Designed data transformation and validation layers to ensure consistency and reliability in data flow.

Developed monitoring dashboards to track service health and integration performance.

Collaborated with DevOps teams to automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins & GitHub Actions).

Impact: Enhanced interoperability and reduced manual reconciliation efforts by 40%, improving system reliability.SIAS – Data Warehousing & Analytics Tool

Integrated with core banking/external systems for datamart transformation and automated reporting.

Delivered accurate reports with analytics for bank management and financial decision-making.Role : Associate Software Developer | Team Size: 18 (Frontend - 9, Backend - 6, QA - 3) | 2021(Aug) - 2024(Sept)Tech Stack: Angular 15, TypeScript, RxJS, REST APIs, Java, SCSS, Oracle WebLogic, Jenkins2016-2020Role : Associate Software Developer | Team Size: 12 (Frontend - 6, Backend - 4, QA - 2) | 2021(Aug) - 2024(Sept)

Developed interactive dashboards and visual reports for data analytics and financial reporting.

Integrated data pipelines from core banking and external systems for automated data transformation.

Implemented filters, charts, and real-time analytics views using RxJS and optimized API handling.

Coordinated with stakeholders to refine requirements and improve visualization accuracy.

Impact: Enabled real-time insights, helping management make data-driven decisions 25% faster.Role : Associate Software Developer | Team Size: 6 (Frontend - 3, Backend - 2, QA - 1) | 2022(Apr) - 2023(June)Tech Stack: Angular 14, Java, REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, Jenkins, GitHub ActionsTech Stack: Angular 12, RxJS, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Bootstrap, JSONRumango Software and Consulting Services Pvt Ltd. - Trainee Engineer2021(June) - 2021(Aug)

Assisted in developing Angular and React-based applications, focusing on building responsive and reusable UIcomponents using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Supported API integration and debugging, helping deliver functional features within deadlines.

Collaborated with senior developers to understand code structure, version control (Git), and CI/CD workflows.

Gained hands-on exposure to Agile/Scrum processes — including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Contributed to creating basic technical documentation and improving project knowledge sharing.ExpressBees – Logistics Management Platform

Developed and optimized key modules for shipment tracking, order management, and delivery updates usingReactJS.

Integrated REST APIs for real-time logistics data and improved overall dashboard performance.

Implemented Redux-based state management and code-splitting to enhance speed and scalability.

Collaborated with backend and QA teams under Agile Scrum practices to ensure timely and quality feature delivery.

Impact: Improved data load time by 30% and enhanced customer experience with real-time shipment visibility.Role : Associate Software Developer | Team Size: 18 (Frontend - 4, Backend - 2, QA - 2) | 2021(Oct) - 2024(Sept)Tech Stack: ReactJS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, REST APIs, Redux, Bootstrap, GitHub Actions
